purpose: Audit of the user's 50-site reading list for NSE Value Lens research.
scope: All 50 entrypoints attempted. Selected research summaries and access pages reviewed; not all archives, books, videos, papers or product features. Search-index verification is distinguished from direct page review. Access descriptions are observations, not a full entitlement or licensing audit.
interpretation: Research relevance is not evidence of profitable 1-20-session NSE trading. No strategy has been validated by this source review.

entries.name: Dataroma
entries.nse_use_or_limitation: Study disclosed US investor holdings; portfolio snapshots are delayed and incomplete trading signals.

entries.name: WhaleWisdom
entries.nse_use_or_limitation: 13F research ideas. Verify publication dates and licensing before using historical downloads or automation.
